jobs.title: Software Engineer - Full Stack
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🟣 About Airgoods

Airgoods is building the future of food and beverage distribution. Helping independent retailers succeed and compete with the largest chains.

Today, we help emerging brands (think Fishwife, Ghia, and David Protein) rapidly grow their wholesale business and earn placement into the nation’s best specialty stores.

We started in January 2023 and have since raised $7M from top investors like Y Combinator and Initialized Capital. We are a fully in-person company, with an office near Madison Square Park in New York City.

👋 Who you’ll work with

Paolo (co-founder and CTO): Paolo studied Computer Science and Economics at Yale. Previously worked as a software engineer at his brother’s startup Momence (YC S20). Grew up in Brazil before coming to the US for college. Played soccer at Yale and loves sports.

Elian (co-founder and COO): Elian studied Economics at Yale, played on the soccer team alongside Paolo, and captained the team for two years. He also worked with Aaron at an emerging VC fund for 1.5 years of his time at Yale. Grew up in Asia and Europe before moving to Milwaukee before college.

Aaron (co-founder and CEO): Aaron studied Economics at Yale, where he met Elian and Paolo. After Yale, he worked at an emerging VC fund in New York with Elian; that fund would later write the first check into Airgoods. He grew up helping his dad run the wholesale side of a brick-and-mortar retail store in Portland, Maine.

You’ll also be working alongside our three fantastic engineers, Emilio, Evan, and Andrés, Pradnaya, and Tomas on the Growth & Ops team!

🏗️ About the role

Airgoods is seeking a driven full-stack engineer. We are on a high-growth trajectory, and we're looking for someone who wants to join us on the journey to building a billion-dollar company.

This position will involve:

  • Engaging deeply from concept to launch in the development of our product. From ideation, through design and implementation, to the final stages of release and iteration.

  • Being obsessed with building beautiful products that create value for our users.

  • Being scrappy and ready to jump in wherever needed to provide the best experience for our users.

  • Full-stack development of our web-app and mobile app.

🚀 Who you are

We are a young company of highly driven and passionate individuals building a billion-dollar business. To thrive in this environment, you’ll have the following characteristics:

  • You are driven with a strong work ethic - our team is committed to going the extra mile, even if it means working long nights and weekends to achieve our goals.

  • You prioritize speed and have a bias for action.

  • You strive for excellence in every aspect of your work - you take ownership of your outcomes and overdeliver on your goals.

  • You’re humble and eager to learn whatever it takes to help our team and our customers succeed.

  • You play for the front of the jersey.

🛠️ What you bring

Must-haves

  • Production-level experience building full-stack applications.

  • Proficient in Typescript to power our frontend React app, and NodeJS and Express backend.

  • Expertise in relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.

  • Attention to detail and passion for building beautiful software.

  • Previous experience shipping production-level code using our tech stack or similar technologies.

Bonus points

  • Experience at a start-up or building products from scratch and bringing them to market.

  • Experience with advanced front-end technologies such as Redux for state management, or modern CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS.

  • Experience in mobile app development, either through native development (iOS/Android) or cross-platform frameworks like React Native.

  • Expertise in NextJS or other server-side JS frameworks.

  • Experience with monorepos using build systems like Turborepo.

  • Experience building scalable backend systems to support high-growth products.

🎁 What we offer

  • $120k - $220k • 0.05% - 0.2%

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Unlimited PTO + two team offsites per year.

  • Expensed dinner in the office Monday - Thursday.

  • $400 / month wellness stipend to encourage you to invest in your health.

  • Commuter benefits to get you to and from the office.

  • Dedicated founders who are committed to building an amazing team and supporting you.

Don’t see a perfect fit? Reach out anyway – exceptional talent always has a home at Airgoods.

jobs.title: Growth - Retailers
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🟣 About Airgoods

Airgoods is building the future of food and beverage distribution.

Today, we help thousands of independent grocers and specialty food stores (like Westside Market, Butterfield Market, and Epicurus Gourmet) discover, order and sell gourmet and emerging brands (like Fishwife, David, and Ghia).

We started in January 2023 and have since raised $7M from top investors like Y Combinator and Initialized Capital. We are a fully in-person company, with an office near Madison Square Park in New York City.

👋 Who you’ll work with

Elian (co-founder and COO): Elian studied Economics at Yale, played on the soccer team alongside Paolo and captained the team for two years. He also worked with Aaron at an emerging VC fund for 1.5 years of his time at Yale. Grew up in Asia and Europe before moving to Milwaukee before college.

Aaron (co-founder and CEO): Aaron studied Economics at Yale, where he met Elian and Paolo. After Yale, he worked at an emerging VC fund in New York with Elian; that fund would later write the first check into Airgoods. He grew up helping his dad run the wholesale side of a brick & mortar retail store in Portland, Maine.

Paolo (co-founder and CTO): Paolo studied Computer Science and Economics at Yale. Previously worked as a software engineer at his brother’s startup Momence (YC S20). Grew up in Brazil before coming to the US for college. Played soccer at Yale and loves sports.

You’ll also collaborate closely with growth & ops teammates Andrés, Pradnaya and Tomas and our engineering team Emilio, Steven, Evan, and Jake.

🏗️ About the role

Retailer Growth at Airgoods is responsible for driving GMV growth with our most important retailers - from high-performing independents to multi-location grocery businesses. You will be the first hire on our Retailer Growth team, building a new function that we plan to grow aggressively over the next 6-12 months, and you’ll work extremely closely day-to-day with Elian (Co-Founder and COO).

This role is essential to growing the demand side of our marketplace: you’ll do this by owning relationships with buyers, driving product adoption, and ensuring retailers have a world class user experience. You’ll both define and execute the playbook for driving retailer growth.

Account management in the grocery industry is changing fast. We operate in the physical world, and the solutions of the future will combine real human relationships with self-improving AI agents. We’ll use agents to move faster and generate insights sooner, so that we can invest more into the work that thrives on human connection.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own a portfolio of top retailers, including multi-location accounts, with clear GMV and growth targets

  • Drive repeat ordering and increased spend through proactive outreach, recommendations, and strategic account planning

  • Build strong, authentic relationships with buyers via email, text, and calls - becoming a trusted partner in their purchasing decisions

  • Use AI to eliminate the operational work: order follow-ups, delivery communication, invoicing, and performance tracking

  • Surface insights from retailer conversations to inform product, engineering, growth initiatives, and company strategy

What Success Looks Like

  • Increasing spend across your portfolio (your primary KPI)

  • Your accounts consistently adopt key product features

  • You maintain high-quality, consistent communication with retailers

  • You have deep understanding of your retailers' businesses, purchasing behavior, and workflows

  • You use AI agents to eliminate manual operations, unlocking speed and insights

🚀 Who you are

  • You enjoy building authentic relationships and care about helping customers' businesses succeed

  • You're curious about innovation in the physical world - blending AI tools with physical products, spaces, and operators

  • You want to build and define a new function, not just execute within an existing playbook

  • You get excited about specialty food and beverage - you're the kind of person who enjoys browsing the shelves of your local cheese shop

🛠️ What you bring

Must haves

  • Strong work ethic – we move fast and work hard (9-9 Monday through Thursday, and later nights + weekends when needed to hit ambitious goals). We care deeply about what we're building and support each other through the pace.

  • Bias for action - you move quickly, experiment thoughtfully, and make decisions with impact in mind.

  • Ownership mentality - you take full ownership of results and hold a high bar for quality in everything you do.

  • Team player - you play for the front of the jersey.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in account management, customer success, sales, or a similar client-facing role

  • You've sold to grocery or other retail businesses

  • You've worked at a startup or marketplace

🎁 What we offer

  • $90k - $150k

  • 0.01% - 0.2% equity in Airgoods

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Unlimited PTO + two team offsites per year.

  • Expensed dinner in the office Monday - Thursday.

  • $400 / month wellness stipend to encourage you to invest in your health.

  • Commuter benefits to get you to and from the office.

  • A tight-knit, ambitious team building a generational company together.

Don’t see a perfect fit?

Reach out anyway – exceptional talent always has a home at Airgoods

jobs.title: In-Store Demo Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🟣 About Airgoods

Airgoods is building the future of food and beverage distribution.

Today, we help thousands of independent grocers and specialty food stores (like Butterfield Market, Happier Grocery, and Meadow Lane) discover, order and sell gourmet and emerging brands (like Fishwife, David, and Sourmilk).

We started in January 2023 and have since raised $7M from top investors like Y Combinator and Initialized Capital. Our office is near Madison Square Park in New York City.

🏗️ About the opportunity

Getting a great product onto the shelf is only half the battle. Shoppers have to try it. Airgoods runs in-store demos for emerging food and beverage brands at some of the best specialty grocers in Manhattan and Brooklyn.

As a Demo Specialist, you're the face of the brand for the day. You set up a tasting table, tell shoppers what makes the product special, and turn samples into sales. You choose which demos you take and when, and you earn more the more you sell.

What a demo looks like

  • Arrive at the store and set up the demo table with the materials provided

  • Sample the product, share the brand's story, and help shoppers find something they love

  • Take photos of your table and setup with your smartphone

  • Note what shoppers say: favorite flavors, questions, reactions

  • Break down and send a quick recap (shopper feedback and photos)

How it works

  • You're an independent contractor (1099). We share open demos and you accept the ones that fit your schedule.

  • Demos are mostly on weekends and weekday evenings. Most demos run 3 hours on the floor, plus a short setup and breakdown.

  • There's no minimum and no cap. Many specialists take around 2-3 demos a week. This works best if you can take more than one demo per month.

  • Product information is provided ahead of each demo so you know what you're sampling.

💰 Compensation

  • $75 per 3-hour demo + 20% of the retail price of every unit sold during your demo, based on the store's sales data

  • The better you sell, the more you earn. For example, sell 10 bottles of $30 olive oil during a demo and you earn $75 + $60 commission = $135

🚀 Who you are

  • You're comfortable starting conversations with strangers and genuinely enjoy it

  • You get excited about specialty food and beverage, the kind of person who browses the shelves of a trendy gourmet grocer for fun

  • You're reliable: when you accept a demo, you show up on time and ready

🛠️ What you bring

Must haves

  • Availability for at least a few hours on weekends or weekday evenings

  • A smartphone for photos and recaps

  • Ability to get to stores in Manhattan and Brooklyn

Bonus points

  • Prior sales or brand ambassador experience

  • Experience in retail, food service, or hospitality

  • Interest or experience in startups or CPG

🎁 Beyond the demos

  • Optional monthly networking events with startup founders, operators, and CPG brand owners

  • Access to startup resources (readings, lectures, and more) if you’re curious about working at a startup

  • Optional 1:1s with the Airgoods founders and team

  • Get to know our team, and be the first to hear when we’re hiring full-time

Don't see a perfect fit?

Reach out anyway. Exceptional talent always has a home at Airgoods.
